title: cephalanthera lonchophylla
intro: Cephalanthera lonchophylla, commonly known as the long-lipped helleborine, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is primarily found in the mountainous regions of China and is known for its medicinal properties. The long-lipped helleborine has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions of antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Cephalanthera lonchophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its health benefits and medicinal effects.
